questions.chapter: Chapter 2: Data Preprocessing, Cleaning, Imputation & Feature Scaling
questions.text: Explain the Data Science Lifecycle (Data Acquisition, Data Cleaning/Wrangling, EDA, Feature Engineering, Model Training, Evaluation, and Deployment). Explain techniques for handling: (a) Missing values (Imputation strategies), (b) Outliers (Z-score and IQR methods), and (c) Feature Scaling (Min-Max Normalization $x' = \frac{x - x_{min}}{x_{max} - x_{min}}$ vs Standardization $z = \frac{x - \mu}{\sigma}$).

questions.chapter: Chapter 1: Introduction to Data Science, Data Types & Data Pipeline
questions.text: Explain the Curse of Dimensionality in high-dimensional data spaces: (a) Exponential growth in volume, (b) Distance concentration phenomenon, and (c) Sparsity of points. Explain statistical visualization tools in EDA: Box Plots, Histograms, Pair Plots, and Correlation Heatmaps.

questions.chapter: Chapter 1: Introduction to Data Science, Data Types & Data Pipeline
questions.text: Derive Principal Component Analysis (PCA) from the maximization of variance / minimization of reconstruction error. Given a $2\text{D}$ dataset, compute the Covariance Matrix $\boldsymbol{\Sigma} = \frac{1}{n}\mathbf{X}^T\mathbf{X}$, find its eigenvalues and eigenvectors, and project the data onto the first principal component.

questions.chapter: Chapter 1: Introduction to Data Science, Data Types & Data Pipeline
questions.text: Explain Singular Value Decomposition (SVD): $\mathbf{A} = \mathbf{U} \boldsymbol{\Sigma} \mathbf{V}^T$. Explain Low-Rank Matrix Approximation (Eckart-Young-Mirsky Theorem) and its application in image compression and collaborative filtering recommender systems.

questions.chapter: Chapter 2: Data Preprocessing, Cleaning, Imputation & Feature Scaling
questions.text: Explain Linear Regression with Ordinary Least Squares (OLS) estimation: $\boldsymbol{\beta} = (\mathbf{X}^T\mathbf{X})^{-1}\mathbf{X}^T\mathbf{y}$. Explain Regularization techniques: (a) Ridge Regression ($L_2$ regularization $\lambda\|\boldsymbol{\beta}\|_2^2$), and (b) Lasso Regression ($L_1$ regularization $\lambda\|\boldsymbol{\beta}\|_1$). How does Lasso perform feature selection?

questions.chapter: Chapter 5: Supervised Learning Foundations (Regression, Decision Trees, k-NN)
questions.text: Explain Logistic Regression for binary classification and derive the cross-entropy loss function $J(\theta) = -\frac{1}{m}\sum [y^{(i)}\ln(h_\theta(x^{(i)})) + (1-y^{(i)})\ln(1-h_\theta(x^{(i)}))]$. Define classification evaluation metrics: Confusion Matrix, Precision, Recall, $F_1$-score, ROC curve, and AUC.

questions.chapter: Chapter 6: Unsupervised Learning (Clustering: k-Means, PCA Dimensionality Reduction)
questions.text: Explain $k$-Means Clustering algorithm and its objective function $J = \sum_{j=1}^k \sum_{i=1}^n \|x_i^{(j)} - c_j\|^2$. Explain the Elbow Method and Silhouette Coefficient for determining optimal $k$. Compare $k$-Means with Hierarchical Clustering (Dendrograms) and DBSCAN (Density-Based Spatial Clustering).

questions.text: Explain the role of Apache Spark (Resilient Distributed Datasets - RDDs, DataFrames, Spark SQL, Spark MLlib) in big data processing. Discuss Data Privacy, GDPR principles, Differential Privacy, and algorithmic bias in AI/Data Science systems.
